conditional_target: Uniform size-s subsets of the current candidate pool whose D-only mean empirical log10 frequency lies within real D group mean +/-0.1 dex. V never selects members or proposals.

steps: Sort candidate features by D empirical log frequency, stable original IDs.
For every first sorted rank i, count second ranks j>i with sum in 2*(target +/- .1); find lower/upper ranks by binary search.
Compute cumulative legal-pair counts. Draw one integer uniformly in [0,total_legal_pairs), invert cumulative counts, obtain exact pair.
Repeat independently for every retained draw. No burn-in or accepted-step issue. Degenerate finite support is valid and reported.
size2_exact_IID.law: Each legal unordered pair has exactly one integer representation, so iid uniform exactly, up to pseudorandomness.
size2_exact_IID.qualification: Exact algorithm self-test + every requested draw exists. Rhat/ESS/initial overlap descriptive only; no empirical fluctuation can invalidate exact iid sampling.

steps: Independently draw three uniform candidate IDs with replacement.
Reject repeated IDs or mean D log frequency outside target +/- .1.
Keep each valid triple, irrespective of V properties, until frozen draw count or 10000000-proposal group budget.
Each valid subset has exactly 3! ordered representations, hence retained draws are iid uniform over legal subsets.
size3_exact_IID.qualification: All requested draws must exist; every group is retained. Underfilled group invalidates complete endpoint. Acceptance count/total proposals saved. V zero is missing in strict score, not grounds for redraw.

steps: Use original real D group as fixed initial ordered distinct member slots.
At each fixed update choose one slot uniformly. Remove its value, hold all other slots.
Compute D-log interval for replacement that preserves group mean target +/- .1.
Uniformly select among eligible candidates not occupying other slots, including current value as a self-loop.
The full-conditional random-scan Gibbs kernel is reversible for uniform ordered valid subsets. Each subset has s! representations, so uniform subset stationary.
Exactly50*s burn-in updates, then every5*s updates retain one draw. Two independently seeded chains. No draw filtering, repeats retained.
size4plus_MCMC.limitation: Necessary finite diagnostics only; no proof all constrained states communicate or globally mix.

strict_and_exploratory.original: log10(nV/NV), any zero/one or unqualified group => complete original Tb missing.
strict_and_exploratory.new_postobservational: log10((nV+.5)/(NV+1)), same real/null operations; score is not original confirmatory Tb.

repair2: Uniform sample real/null Monte Carlo budget enlargement approved by root before any formal draw; original qualification kept. No thresholds changed or groups filtered. Original strict endpoint remains missing on V zero; H1a can calibrate separately if H1b unavailable.
MonteCarlo_limitations: Same-real-group starts for heatbath may share slow/global components; Rhat/ESS and turnover do not prove all feasible subsets communicate.
Fixed-margin null draws are serially dependent within each of two state chains. Three workers score snapshots only; no extra null state chain.
B99 raw p resolution 1/100; approximate MCMC rank calibration, not exact iid permutation p or nominal FWER guarantee.
